name: net_route_t1_hb_iron_hammer
description: VUH-1789 T1 loopback: explicit required families; mirror, population, targeting all and two-player Normal HP. Native spawn, motion and death smoke; no T2/T3 admission.

steps.expr: location(0)==[4,21,0,1,26,32767] and location(1)==location(0) and all(any(a['name']=='P_EX100' for a in actors(i)) for i in range(2))
all(any(a['objectId']==oid and a['hp']>0 for a in enemies(i)) for i in range(2) for oid in [2405]) and enemy_hps(0)==enemy_hps(1)
[log_matches(r'\[coop-difficulty\] scale .*objectId='+str(oid)+r' .*players=2 mode=1 hp=(?P<hp>\d+)->(?P<scaledHp>\d+) max=(?P<max>\d+)->(?P<scaledMax>\d+)',0) for oid in [2405]]

all(len(rows)>0 and all(int(row['scaledMax'])==(int(row['max'])*1600+999)//1000 for row in rows) for rows in saved['scaled']) and all(any(a['objectId']==oid and a['maxHp'] in [int(row['scaledMax']) for row in saved['scaled'][n]] for a in enemies(i)) for i in range(2) for n,oid in [(0, 2405)])
steps.message: Each required family must actually spawn and scale at two-player Normal

steps.expr: log_count('[enemy-target] all=1',0)>0 and log_count('[enemy-target] search-swap ok=1',0)>0 and log_count('driven=1',1)>0
steps.message: All-player target hook and native mirror driving must be active; remote attack eligibility is a separate clone-scope limit
